title: vd:auto-loop goal-state.json
description: Per-iteration model-written state file. Atomic-write only via state-rw.sh.

iteration.description: Loop iteration count (zero-based; starts at 0 on first invocation).

status.description: Current goal status. `achieved` is provisional until two-vote gate confirms.

evidence.description: Up to 20 short evidence strings describing what's been done.

next_action.description: Concrete next step the model intends to take.

tokens_used.description: Cumulative tokens consumed; populated by probe-token-usage.sh.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of loop start; set once and immutable.

last_update.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of most recent state-write.

last_diff_signature.description: sha256 of `git diff --stat` at last update; used by drift watchdog.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id of the live loop owner.
